lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 10 to 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank. The spots are arranged in a grid-like matrix with regular spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular spot centroids, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), maintaining a linear trajectory across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, primarily concentrated in the ventral half of the fin's visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller diameter spots is visible on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
